description: Machine-readable V1 scope catalog for Storefront Private Apps. Every scope is least-privilege and mostly READ. The only write scopes are narrow, app-owned surfaces (attribution) and a UI-launch capability (widgets:launch) that grants no data access. No scope in this catalog can reach a compliance-floor surface; see forbidden-scopes.json.

scopes.grants: Read published catalog products and collections for the installed tenant (GET /catalog/products, /catalog/products/{handle}).
scopes.dataMinimization: Public storefront catalog data only. No draft/internal-only fields beyond what the storefront already renders publicly.

scopes.grants: Read a minimized order list and order detail (GET /orders, /orders/{id}).
scopes.dataMinimization: Order id, status, currency, line SKUs/handles, quantities, subtotals/totals, timestamps. NO raw checkout payload, NO signed-cart material, NO tax-computation internals.
scopes.pii: minimal — customer identity defaults to an opaque customer hash stable per (tenant, app-install-id): the same customer resolves to the same hash within one app install (so the app stays internally consistent across its own order.created/order.fulfilled/attribution.finalized events), but the hash is NOT comparable across apps on the same tenant, preventing cross-app re-identification. No email/name/address unless a future, separately-approved elevated scope exists.

scopes.grants: Subscribe to order lifecycle events (order.created, order.fulfilled) delivered as signed CloudEvents.
scopes.dataMinimization: Same minimized order shape as orders:read:minimal, delivered in the event payload.
scopes.pii: minimal — customer hash only by default (stable per (tenant, app-install-id); not comparable across apps on the same tenant).

scopes.grants: Read minimal marketing-relevant customer state (e.g. marketing consent) keyed by opaque customer id; subscribe to customer.marketing_consent.updated.
scopes.dataMinimization: Opaque customer id + marketing consent state + timestamps. NO age/identity evidence, NO verification result, NO document data, NO raw contact PII by default.
scopes.pii: minimal and named — consent state keyed by an opaque customer id stable per (tenant, app-install-id) and not comparable across apps on the same tenant; never age/identity evidence.

scopes.grants: Read inventory availability/quantity for the tenant's catalog (GET /inventory) and subscribe to inventory.changed.
scopes.dataMinimization: Availability, quantity, and policy per variant/SKU only.
Aggregate report snapshots only; no row-level PII beyond what the minimal order/customer scopes already permit.

scopes.grants: Write app-owned attribution/commission records via the idempotent POST /attribution endpoint.
scopes.dataMinimization: Writes only into the app's own attribution namespace. Cannot alter orders, price, tax, checkout validity, or any platform record.
scopes.pii: none — references order id + attribution id + opaque customer hash.

scopes.grants: Activate declared sandboxed widget placements and mint short-lived widget launch tokens for the app's platform-managed iframes.
scopes.dataMinimization: Launch token carries tenant, env, slot, route, optional product handle, locale, theme hints, trace id — never secrets or customer PII.
scopes.verification: The token's aud/sub are the app INSTALL id (not the tenant) — an app verifying a launch token MUST check aud/sub match its own install id, so a token leaked to one install can't be replayed against a sibling install on the same tenant.
